title: From Miami, Flávio Bolsonaro Calls Himself Brazil's Leader
dek: A day after fleeing a passport order, the defeated candidate posted a letter alleging fraud, then softened “rightful president” to “leader.” His own party accepts Lula's win.
body: He posted “rightful president,” then changed it to “leader.” Lula won by 4.4 million votes; his own party accepts the result.

panels.label: Bolsonaro Says
panels.text: He calls the runoff “an electoral fraud” and himself a victim of “political persecution,” and says he will lead the opposition from the US.

panels.label: Lula and the Court Say
panels.text: Lula calls the flight “shameful”; the electoral authority says the vote ran fully within the law. Observers and his party accept the result.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: He speaks of fraud, Brasília of flight from justice; beneath both is whether Brazil’s right follows a leader abroad.
